items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A guy named Weinberg used to book them.

ctx.x: Who did? Each of the different bands...

No, it was a tour down there they called the Weinberg Tour. A guy named Weinberg used to book them. He bought all the dance halls from New York to Florida, and he’d send the bands down there, and they played. Dizzy’s band came through there.
What did the Mombassa Club look like? How was it set up?
